retrieval.protocol: Full catalog. Warm users only (user had an organic click). Relevance is random-policy clicks the user did not already click in the organic log. Already-clicked organic items are removed from the ranked list. Macro-average over users. als is the previously published configuration. als_tuned, itemknn, ease, and hybrid were selected on the organic validation slice (dates >= 20220418) and refit on the full organic log.

uncalibrated_full_train.protocol: Pointwise click model fit on every organic impression and scored on every random-policy impression. Retrieval feature is the previous ALS dot product. No probability calibration.

with_selected_retriever.protocol: Same full-organic training protocol as the uncalibrated ranker. The retrieval feature is als_tuned, the pure retriever with the best organic validation objective.

calibration.note: Models are fit only on organic rows before the validation date. Isotonic and Platt are fit on the later organic rows. The method with lower validation log loss is applied to the random-policy test. Test labels are not used to choose the calibrator.
